description: Professional services: Management consulting, business consulting, expert consulting, coaching
typical_workflows: Customer acquisition via network, referrals, and LinkedIn
Initial meetings and needs analysis (often 1-2h per client)
Project delivery: Workshops, analyses, coaching sessions
Follow-up: Proposal follow-ups, client relationship management
common_pain_points: Acquisition consumes productive time: 30-40% for marketing instead of delivery
Proposals take too long: Each one needs individual customization
Standardization difficult: Every client wants an individual solution
Scaling only with more time: Capacity limit for solo/small teams
Marketing often neglected: No time for regular content
Knowledge management lacking: Starting each project from scratch
Pricing uncertainty: Hourly rates vs. value-based pricing
ai_opportunities: Automate proposal creation: Templates + GPT = 5 instead of 120 minutes
Content marketing: LinkedIn posts, blog articles, newsletters via GPT
Report generation: Automatically create analyses and presentations
Meeting documentation: Transcription + summary + action items
Research assistants: Client analysis, market research, competitor analysis
Email automation: Follow-ups, nurturing sequences, appointment confirmations
CRM automation: Lead scoring, activity tracking, pipeline management
Knowledge management: RAG systems for company know-how
typical_tools: Microsoft Office / Google Workspace for documents
Excel / Google Sheets for calculations and lists
Zoom / Microsoft Teams for online meetings
No or very simple CRM (often Excel lists)
Manual accounting or cloud accounting software

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: GPT-powered proposal creation
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Create proposals from templates in 5 instead of 30 minutes. Client data + briefing → GPT generates customized proposal with pricing, services, timeline.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Create templates as prompts, workflow: Client data → GPT → Word export

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Automated LinkedIn content pipeline
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Generate, adapt, and schedule weekly expert posts via GPT. Topic list → GPT → 3-5 posts per week.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Build topic backlog, prompt templates, posting schedule

realistic_quick_wins_solo.title: Automated meeting minutes
realistic_quick_wins_solo.description: Zoom/Teams recordings → automatic transcription → summary → action items → minutes via email.
realistic_quick_wins_solo.implementation: Integration with Zoom/Teams, automatic dispatch after meeting

realistic_quick_wins_team.title: Central knowledge management with RAG
realistic_quick_wins_team.description: All project documents, best practices, templates in a searchable knowledge base. Team finds info in seconds instead of hours.
realistic_quick_wins_team.tool: Notion AI or Custom RAG with Pinecone
realistic_quick_wins_team.implementation: Collect documents, structure, set up RAG

realistic_quick_wins_kmu.title: Enterprise CRM with AI pipeline management
realistic_quick_wins_kmu.description: Automatic lead scoring, pipeline forecasts, next-best-actions for sales.
realistic_quick_wins_kmu.implementation: CRM migration, define processes, train team

success_metrics: Proposal hit rate: % of won projects
Time-to-offer: Hours from inquiry to proposal
Utilization rate: % productive vs. administrative time
Client lifetime value: Value per client over time
Referral rate: % of clients who refer others
